text:
Riley (CS): Heads-up — CardinalOne dry-run tomorrow 10:30 PT. Account health = watch (trial, some churn signals from flaky response quality). Renewal in ~28 days. Request: one-page preflight we can send customers that covers warmup/prefill, minimal batching, streaming fallback, and a one-click feedback capture. Also want a quick triage matrix for post-call issues.

Ben (Eng): Proposal: minimal config to stabilize first-token and tail latencies: enable prefix prefetch for top_7 prompts, batch mode=continuous, target_batch_ms=24, max_batch_size=12. Streaming enabled with chunk_size=256 and ``end_on_error=false`` so partial output is returned. Recommend synthetic dry-run 25m prior with 25 concurrent prefill requests. Warmup curl we can give customer: 
```bash
# 25 parallel warmup
for i in $(seq 1 25); do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/route/cardinal-prod/warmup \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
    -d '{"prompt":"sample warmup"}' &
done; wait
```

Hannah (SRE): SRE constraints: route timeout 5.5s, circuit-breaker at 4% errors over 2m. Add alert: `sum(rate(redwood_route_errors_total{route=\"cardinal-prod\"}[2m])) / sum(rate(redwood_route_requests_total{route=\"cardinal-prod\"}[2m])) > 0.04` for 3m. If p95>1s for 3m, flip to canary model and notify CS. Also add a lightweight dashboard panel showing kv_hit_rate and first_token_p50.

Sophie (PM): I'll own the customer-facing checklist and the feedback flow. Plan: 3-question micro-survey sent within 20m of the call (latency OK / quality OK / blockers yes/no) and an optional text field. Negative sentiment auto-tags renewal risk in CRM. I'll also prepare a 1-box triage matrix: 
- latency spike -> check warmup logs, KV hit rate -> consider increasing prefill concurrency
- errors -> inspect route error logs -> trigger rollback to fallback-model
- quality regressions -> capture sample prompts + outputs, escalate to ML ops

Riley (CS): DryRunBot — can you schedule the synthetic run and capture kv_hit_rate and first-token latencies pre/post so we can show the delta on the call? Also post a tiny diagnostic command customers can run if they spot issues.

DryRunBot: Warmup scheduled by Ben: id=drw-2001001234, run_at=2026-12-01T09:55:00Z, concurrency=25, route=cardinal-prod. Artifacts: /warmups/drw-2001001234/results.json (contains kv_hit_rate and first_token samples). :white_check_mark:

Ben (Eng): For private installs recommend KV cache 512MB for modest prompt sizes, 768MB if many short prompts. Suggest prefix_TTL=10m and max_async_prefill=48. For hosted customers use r4-serving profile with reserved burst for the 30m window.

Hannah (SRE): I'll add the alert and dashboard snippet to the SRE runbook and attach a brief pager play for the call window. Pager only if errors>6% or p95>1200ms for 2m to avoid noise.

Sophie (PM): Action items recap: Sophie builds checklist+survey+triage-matrix, Ben posts final config + warmup artifact, Hannah adds alerts/dashboard/pager, Riley sends one-page customer preflight and runs the dry-run 20m prior, and DryRunBot will post warmup results to this thread.

Riley (CS): Thanks team — I'll draft the one-page checklist and the little diagnostic curl (to test kv hit rate + first-token) and paste here by EOD.

Ben (Eng): Diagnostic command for customers to run quickly: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/route/cardinal-prod/diagnose \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"checks":["kv_hit_rate","first_token_latency"]}'
```

DryRunBot: Warmup completed: drw-2001001234 - kv_hit_rate pre=0.04 post=0.81, first_token_p50 pre=1.05s post=0.18s. Results: /warmups/drw-2001001234/results.json :rocket:

Riley (CS): Perfect. We'll show that live. I'll post the customer-facing checklist and the micro-survey link shortly.
